validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed, strong, TWO independent origins. (1) MEED (industry trade press, the row's own cited source) explicitly lists the package: 'Laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-4 to EWPS-6, covering 370km' as one of the EPC packages of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3); url_verifier OK 200 with exact tokens 'EWPS-4 to EWPS-6', '370', '56-inch'. (2) DMS Projects has a DEDICATED page for this exact package, 'Master Gas System Expansion - Phase 3 - Package 6 - EWPS-4 to EWPS-6 Pipeline' (PRJ00030607); url_verifier OK 200 with token 'EWPS-4 to EWPS-6' — an independent project-tracking database, not tracing to MEED or GEM. Program-level corroboration: JPT/SPE (OK 200, 'Master Gas System'+'2028'), DMS overview (OK 200), SICIM EPC contractor 'in progress' page (OK 200), Pipeline Journal (OK 200). Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: correct — a 56-inch east-west gas TRANSMISSION trunk (national Master Gas System backbone), commodity gas, PipelineType transmission. Not gathering/process/lateral. DUPLICATE CHECK: P6723 ('EWPS-4-EWPS-6 "3"', also 185 km, 56 in) is the PARALLEL line 3 of the SAME EWPS-4->EWPS-6 corridor; MEED and DMS both name 'pipelines three AND four' / Package 6 as covering the pair over 370km — i.e., two real parallel physical pipes, so P6723 (line 3) and P6724 (line 4) are NOT a double-count. No duplicate against any other roster PID. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco 100% correct — Aramco owns/operates the Master Gas System. FuelSource/Fuel Gas correct. Endpoints EWPS-4 (East-West Pump Station 4) -> EWPS-6 within Saudi Arabia; province not stated per-segment so left unfilled (no fabrication). SPEC: Diameter 56 in explicitly confirmed by MEED + DMS. LengthKnown 185 km is the one CAVEAT — sources state 370 km for the PAIR (lines 3+4); GEM split it 185+185, arithmetically consistent (185x2=370) and a defensible per-line modeling choice, so no material disagreement, but the 185 per-line figure is inferred, not directly sourced. Capacity blank and left blank — MGS-3 adds ~3.2 bscfd across ~4,153 km total; no defensible per-segment capacity, so not fabricated. StartYear1 2028 matches the Q4 2028 program target.
